text_block_list.text: Day after failed scouting. Walking tree-lined street—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Was City-san arguing by track earlier, right?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: With trainer, right? Pretty loud, hope she's okay...
Something happen? Better check...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —So meaning, shouldn't train?

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: No-no, not that! Just no bulky muscles ruining figure! Promised won't wreck body!

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Focus form instead! Gotta run beautifully! Oh, practice victory live too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Makes me faster? Helps win races?

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Ah, that? Fine-fine, I'll handle matches! Just run and win!

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Protects image! Most beautiful run, crowds captivated by Gold City winning! Flawless plan, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Wrong. Wrong, wrong, wrong! Not what I wanted...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Hey... why?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Said "make top horse girl". "#1 horse girl shining on turf".

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Then... why like this...!

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Eh? Feelings haven't changed! I mean, you're "Gold City", right?

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Famous, cool model!

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Told you, leave to me! Plan image, make shine!

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Just follow orders! For your sake! That's what trainers do, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Ah, you... why...

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, who're you? Outsider, shut trap.
choice_data_list: If you’re a trainer, listen to her more!
If you’re a trainer, listen to her more!

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Say what? Arrogant brat...!

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait!... What's with her? Went out of way to make shine.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Terrible attitude~... Whatever, find another girl.
...Can't leave Gold City alone. Chase after!
Searched whole school, nowhere. Where else—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Scared me~... seriously, what up~? Chasing City?
Explained situation, asked if knew where Gold City went.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, looking for City? ...Ehe~, sketchy.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wanna scout City for looks too, right~? Yeah, looks crazy good, but super bad.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No different from manager guy then, y'know~...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Just asking, why obsessed with City anyway?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan: "Support her", huh~...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like, thought about *how* wanna support?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nothing yet? Seriously? Pretty bad, no?
choice_data_list: I don’t know anything about her yet
I don’t know anything about her yet

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: I want to talk to her, I want to know her

text_block_list.text: —Pitched Tosen Jordan: wanted to discuss and decide together with her.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...H-Hmm? Well, how'd I know~...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What's with expectant look? Put on spot here~...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, back off~! Don't want this~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —Gah, following~? Jordan really don't know!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No way, stay away~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Phew, made it this far—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Still chasing~?! Let go~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Agh~! Dunno, really dunno! Stop bugging me~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Only spot City'd go is riverbed anyway...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah, crap.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, wait second!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Don't tell told you, okay~? For real! City mad is legit terrifying!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey! Listening~?!
